titleAr: طلب إلغاء الباقة السنوية واسترداد الشهور اللي ما بدأتش
titleEn: Request cancellation of a yearly package and a refund of the months not started

ar: عايز الغي الباقة السنوية واسترد فلوسي
هرجع كام لو الغيت الباقة السنوية؟
en: How do I cancel my yearly package and get a refund?
How much would I get back?

steps: Wallet > Cancel the yearly package shows the figures: months not started, their value, wallet debt settled first, refund to your card
The figures come from the same function the operator uses, so they are what the operator would execute
Request cancellation and refund > Yes, send the request: a request is filed (single-use token bound to those figures)
Our team runs the cancellation (operator.yearly-refund) and sends any card refund by hand; no money moves when you confirm
edgeCases: The month you are in is never refunded; a refund in the last month is nothing, so no request can be made
Wallet debt is settled first out of the refund; if it covers everything no money goes back
One request at a time per store; a double click is one request
If the figures move between preview and confirm (a month began, debt changed) the request is refused and you preview again
A renewal queued behind the package: cancellation is not offered here (queued_periods)
Owner only; staff and other stores get nothing
gaps: The card refund itself is sent by a person; no SLA is shown
